renderNoteId.label: Render Note
renderNoteId.description: An existing note to turn into a second view of body metrics. Selecting it converts that note into a render note pointing at the widget; clearing it reverts the previously-chosen note to a text note.

weightUnit.label: Weight Unit
weightUnit.description: Label shown beside every weight metric. Recorded numbers are never converted, so switching this relabels existing data rather than recalculating it.

lengthUnit.label: Length Unit
lengthUnit.description: Label shown beside every length metric such as waist or chest, and the unit height is entered in. Recorded numbers are never converted.

height.label: Height
height.description: Your height in the length unit above. When set, BMI is worked out from the Weight metric. Leave at 0 to hide BMI.
